text: Narzbash is an Orsimer residing in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell. She is a member of Bothamul's group, Ropefish.
Najan is a Redguard residing near the Nilata Ruins Wayshrine, Bangkorai, in . His wife Adeena went missing in the ruins because of his dealings with the Daedra.
Naanelore is an Altmer who can be found northeast of Colosseum of the Old Ways in Artaeum. He cannot be interacted with.
Nalirsewen is an Altmer merchant who can be found south of the Ceporah Tower in Artaeum. She is the proprietor of the Tower's Shadow Market.
Naireorwe is an Altmer who can be found in the Academy Guest Wing in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Nakjhan is a Khajiit who can be found in the Academy Guest Wing in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Nahsirih is a Redguard residing in Hallin's Stand, bangkorai, in . Before the Imperial invasion of the town, she was one of Captain Dhakir at-Nimr's soldiers.
Nam Indoril is a Dunmer ghost located inside the House Indoril Crypt, protecting his own skull from pilferers. He is an obstruction during "Legacy of the Ancestors."
Naliara is a Redguard residing in King's Haven Pass, Summerset. She works as a scribe for Mehdze.
Liranaire is a Khajiit residing in Kerbol's Hollow. She can be found near the eastern city gate.
Narluz is a Khajiit thief residing in Rimmen. He can be found gambling with Mulnus Veterna and Plexica Scavius. He has no unique dialogue.
Narazbiri is a Khajiit blacksmith who appears in the Market of Fresh Delights at Riverhold in Northern Elsweyr. She has no unique dialogue.
Naraku is a Khajiit who appears throughout various settlements talking to Elazura in Northern Elsweyr.
Naihana is a Khajiit residing in Rimmen. She can be found fawning over the Khajiit bathing in the public square.
Najeepa Swims-in-Blood is an Argonian who resides in the Arena.
Nahdahni is a Khajiit residing in Alinor, Summerset. She can be found sweeping the floor outside Irene Epinard's House.
Nakan-Obar is a Dunmer member of the Erabenimsun Tribe residing at Erabenimsun Camp, in Vvardenfell.
Naldien is an injured Altmer that has taken shelter, like most of the other residents, within the Elinhir sewers away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild.
Nam-Medul is an Argonian residing in the Solitude Fighters Guild in Solitude.
Nalur Garvon is an Dunmer weaponsmith residing in the Bog Brokers marketplace at northern Lilmoth.
Nahruzah is a character located in Sentinel, Alik'r Desert, in .
Naseiran is a Redguard located in the Rain Catcher Fields, Alik'r Desert, in . He is the father of Almur and Overseer Jahi.
Nartise Merys is a Dunmer located at Souther Guard Ruins, Southern Elsweyr, in .
Namoroth is an Orsimer located in the Barkbite Stronghold, Grahtwood, in .
Names-the-Leaves is an Argonian residing in the Slag Town Outlaws Refuge.
Naryu is a Dunmer Morag Tong assassin and one of the romanceable characters in .

Nedes, also known as Nedic people, were an ancient race of Men long extinct who existed throughout Cyrodiil, Hammerfell, Skyrim, and Morrowind during the Merethic Era and First Era. The Adabal-a reveals they consisted of several indigenous tribes in Cyrodiil, including the Kothringi, the Al-Gemha, Men-of-Ge, Al-Hared and Men-of-Ket. While Nedes are often considered a single race of man, it has been said that they are more accurately a wide panoply of extremely varied mannish cultures and tribes who eventually would become more united through interactions within Tamriel. The Imperial race can trace their roots to the Nedic people after they bred with the Atmorans. The most notable of Nedes is
Nethyn Valno is a Dunmer living in the Redoran Stronghold of Marandus. He is also a member of House Redoran.
Nelmyne Andules is a Dunmer commoner. She lives in her shack on the docks in the village of Khuul.

Nelos Onmar is a Dunmer Rogue who resides in Pelagiad, Morrowind. He is a bandit who makes his living robbing travelers along the roads near Pelagiad, and can be found having a drink at the Halfway Tavern.
Neldris Llervu is a Dunmer witchhunter who is a sleeper for the Sixth House. If the Nerevarine kills Dagoth Hlevul, Neldris is released from his trance.
Nebia Amphia is an Imperial Priestess living in Ebonheart on the Ascadian Isles in Morrowind. She is a member of the Imperial Legion and resides inside the Hawkmoth Legion Garrison.
Nedhelorn is a Bosmer drillmaster living in Ebonheart, Hawkmoth Legion Garrison who also serves in the Imperial Legion.

Navam Veran is a Dunmer caravaner. He runs the Silt Strider service in Ald'ruhn. Navam remains at his post, awaiting customers. He can never be found anywhere. He is not involved in any quests. Like all other caravaners, raising his disposition will lead to better travel fares. He wears a set of Common Clothing and is unarmed.
Nelacar is an Altmer mage exiled from the College of Winterhold for "bad research." He resides within The Frozen Hearth inn.
Nenya is an Altmer and the personal steward of Siddgeir, Jarl of Falkreath. She lives in the Jarl's Longhouse. Before that, she was also the steward of the former Jarl, Dengeir of Stuhn.

Nazeem is a Redguard citizen in who resides in the upstairs room of The Drunken Huntsman. He, along with his wife Ahlam, owns Chillfurrow Farm, which is located south of Whiterun. During waking hours, he visits the marketplace and inspects the wares on display, while conversing with, and insulting, various merchants. In the afternoon, he wanders around town, and then finishes his day by sitting in The Drunken Huntsman. He also goes to bed there instead of Chillfurrow Farm. He speaks in a condescending manner toward the Dragonborn and the citizens of Whiterun, and claims to advise Balgruuf the Greater on political matters. Ironically, he has never actually visited Dragonsreach itself. The Jar
Nazir is a Redguard member of the Dark Brotherhood. After the entrance quest, Nazir is the one who gives the Dragonborn their first set of missions/contracts.

Neetrenaza is an Argonian residing just outside the walls of Windhelm, in the Argonian Assemblage. He is typically found during waking hours at the Windhelm Docks, where he works as a laborer. More specifically, he often mans the workbench and grindstone there.

Nelkir is the son of Balgruuf the Greater, Jarl of Whiterun. He mentions that he knows he does not have the same mother as his brother and sister, Frothar and Dagny, information given to him by the Whispering Lady.

Master Neloth is a Dunmer Mage who resides in the upper tower of Tel Naga in Sadrith Mora. He is a master-ranked member and Councilor of the Great House Telvanni and is involved in the Telvanni storyline as well as the Main Quest. He is respected by the other masters of the House and is feared by the citizens of Sadrith Mora. Arara Uvulas serves as his mouth.
Nelrene is a Dark Seducer who resides in the Shivering Isles. She is the captain of the guard in Crucible.
Neminda is a Redguard drillmaster and member of House Redoran who can be found in the Redoran Council Entrance in the city of Ald'ruhn. She is a quest giver for House Redoran.
Nelmil Hler is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, Redoran Canton. He is a sleeper under the influence of Dagoth Hlevul.
Nelso Salenim is a Dunmer mage, who resides in the Telvanni Council House Entry.

Neria Relethyl was a resident of Gnisis during the Fourth Era. She was the only survivor of the Red Year in Gnisis, when it was destroyed. Later, she resides in the Blacklight, the capital city of Morrowind.
Nervana Verelas is a Dunmer Crusader and a member of the Tribunal Temple in . She can be found in the Ordinator Barracks of the Hall of Justice in Vivec City.
Nelyn Sadri is a Dunmer sorcerer. He resides behind a trapped door in the Daedric Ruin of Yansirramus.
Nestaarie is a Altmer soldier, and member of the Aldmeri Dominion found in Eagle's Strand.
Nemyn is an Dunmer spirit found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and after the ghosts have returned to the temple.

Neomi Malyne is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall. She can be found west of the Daggerfall Cathedral standing next to Michebert Montieu. Both of them seem to be very smitten with each other.
Nedeni Tenim is a Dunmer Witchhunter residing at the Ordinator Barracks in the Temple Canton of Vivec City. She is a member of the Tribunal Temple.
Nemarc is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is the magister of their branch in Daggerfall.
Nedasilf Too-Bold is a Nord beggar found at various locations throughout Deshaan. Giving him gold counts toward the "Give to the Poor" achievement.
Nendilir is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Elden Root.
Nazura is a Khajiit chef. She sells her wares at her stall, Nazura's Nibbles, at the stalls of the Redfur Trading Post.
Nellor is a Bosmer innkeeper residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Nenime is an Altmer grocer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Nelix Fly-Breath is a deceased Argonian Smuggler whose body may be found in the Dralas Ancestral Tomb.
Nelvon Radas is a Dunmer enforcer residing in the cave of Zaintirari.
Navil Ienith is a Dunmer Agent and hostile Skill trainer residing in Dren's Villa. He is a member of the Camonna Tong.
Neetinei is an Argonian Slave working on the Dren Plantation.
Nela Sethri is a Dunmer brewer who works at The Watch House in Davon's Watch.
Nazaneen is a Redguard residing in the city of Kozanset, Alik'r Desert.
Nazdura is an Orsimer member of the Star-Gazers residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth and in the Star-Gazers' Observatory.
Nendryl Vadryon is a Dunmer patron of The Hissing Guar in Kragenmoor.
Navanu Andules is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Nerassil the Bound is an Altmer ghost in that runs Telenger's Emporium in the city of Skywatch.
Nethrin is a Bosmer residing in The Waxing Crescent, in the city of Rawl'kha.
Nenwirah is a Redguard residing in the Caravan Company Depot in Dragonstar.
Nebezh is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Desert city of Bergama.
Neloth Sandras is a Dunmer part of the outlaw gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Davon's Watch.
Neetzara is an Argonian residing in The Gray Mire, Grahtwood.
Nelinar is an Altmer residing in the city of Sentinel. He can be found at the Sentinel Bazaar.
Neiral is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers, and resides at their camp in northern Greenshade.
Navren Daral is a powerful Dunmer member of the Scaled Court. He is found inside Skyreach Hold.
Nazrajah is a Redguard moneylender residing in the Outlaws Refuge underneath the city of Riften.
Neeti-Nur is an Argonian member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Riften. He is responsible for keeping the guildhall orderly.
Naveed is a Redguard who is typically found at the docks near the city of Sentinel, Alik'r.

The Necrotic Hoarvor is a pet Hoarvor included with . It can be acquired as reward for completing the Imperial City Challenger Veteran Dungeon achievement. It is also a creature that appears in several locations.
Nelanya is an Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance in who resides at the Toothmaul Gully in Auridon.
Nedaegaer is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, Greenshade. When the Shrouded Vale disappears again, Nedaegaer decides to stay behind in Woodhearth.
Nenvalion is an Altmer soldier, and member of the Thalmor found at their headquarters in Woodhearth.
Nebutil is an Argonian patron of the Sundry Swills in Alten Corimont.
Neeta-Li is an Argonian residing in the town of Alten Corimont.
Nednor is a Bosmer residing in the city of Orsinium, located in Haggler's Bluff.
Nazhataga is an Orsimer found in the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium. She is impossible to be interacted with.
Nervyna Selos is a Dunmer, and the owner of Darkshade Caverns. She is found investigating the recent disturbance inside.
Nengenil is an Altmer residing in the city of Firsthold, Auridon.
Nazala is a Khajiit Commoner of the Baandari Clan. She is found at the College of Aldmeri Propriety.
Nerus Lucllus is an Imperial merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, Wanderlust Wares, in Morkul Stronghold.
Nazhag is an Orsimer enchanter working in Clan Longhouse in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar.
Nebzez is a Redguard commoner residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Nebuin is a Redguard found in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Nemalarian is an Altmer found in Hubalajad Palace's courtyard in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Nazd is a character found in the east halls of Anvil Castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Nazz is a Redguard found in the east halls of Anvil Castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Nebia Nerva is an Imperial found inside the castle in Anvil.
Nedtharond is a Bosmer found in Anvil Outlaws Refuge in Anvil on the Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Neransi Faleria was the first son of Lord Nunex Faleria and Lady Faleria.

Nedthion is a Bosmer residing in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost. He cannot be interacted with directly, but can be heard in conversation with Voranyarin as to the pronunciation of the word "quay." He is located by the entrance to Cat's Eye Quay.
Nellic Sterone is a Breton scholar residing near the Stonechewer Goblin Camp near Wayrest. He expresses his wish to live with the goblins, who he believes are misunderstood.
Nelandare is an Altmer noble member of Queen Ayrenn's entourage found in Tanzelwil, Auridon.
Nendirume is an Altmer member of the Star-Gazers. She is seeking help in order to prevent the Scaled Court from harvesting further nirncrux within Skyreach Hold.
Nerantar is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild. He can be found at their branch located in Dune.
Nesullinwe is an Altmer gatherer residing in Belkarth. She can be found perusing the horses at the Bell and Bridle stables. She has no unique dialogue.
Netapatuu is an Argonian scholar. He was on an expedition to seek out Hakra, an ancient Companion, when he was driven away by the Worm Cult.
Nedras the Sly is a Bosmer member of the Bitterhand Bandits. He joined out of desperation as he needed a way to provide money for her sickly sister Gendinora's medicine.
Nelmir the Hearteater is a Bosmer and leader of the bandit gang found at the Highlander Camp in Cyrodiil.

Nendaer the Ironbark is a Bosmer spirit found in his tomb located in Vinedusk Village. He was the original founder and leader of the Vinedusk Rangers and is still revered by its current members to this day.
Neronnir is a Bosmer residing in Karthdar, first met in its Sacred Cave. He is the author of his own journal.
Nelmia Othrelas is a Dunmer commoner and patron of The Snakeskin Suds in Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in . She can be seen in the back along with her brother Remyon Othrelas.
Nelmil Gilvilo is a Dunmer member of the Ember-Eye Slavers. He is found within the Underground Sepulcher with his men.
Nero Rosentius is an Imperial member of the Stonefire Cult. He is part of the trio that opened the Dark Anchor in Arenthia.
The Nervous Patron is a Nord contractor for the quest "The Dark Brotherhood Forever." He resides in the Candlehearth Hall in Windhelm.
Nemic Zurric is a Breton fisher residing in Vivec City. He can be found fishing near the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise. He offers no unique dialogue.
Nerandas is a Dunmer residing in Pinsun in Vvardenfell. They are the head of the Black Snails members located in this cave.
Neria Lerano is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell, in . She is the child of Gilan Lerano and Bravora Faren, and her brother is Mils Lerano.
Netch Gouger Deadeyes are generic goblins residing in several locations in . They are members of the Netch Gouger Tribe.
Netch Gouger Witches are generic goblins residing in several locations in . They are members of the Netch Gouger Tribe.
Archmagister Nelos Otheri is a Dunmer wizard who serves as the leader of House Telvanni. He resides within his tower of Tel Naga in Sadrith Mora on Vvardenfell.
Navam Ginith is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni and an apprentice of Divayth Fyr residing in Tel Fyr on Vvardenfell.
Navam Hlen is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found in the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Netch Gouger Ironskins are generic goblins residing in several locations in . They are members of the Netch Gouger Tribe.
Netch Gouger Ravengers are generic goblins residing in several locations in . They are members of the Netch Gouger Tribe.
Netch Gouger Reavers are generic goblins residing in several locations in . They are members of the Netch Gouger Tribe.
Netch Gouger Spellfiends are generic goblins residing in several locations in . They are members of the Netch Gouger Tribe.

Natrada is a Khajiit residing in Rimmen. She can be found just outside the gate with her camel Chumbley proselytizing the return of "Alkosh" to the Sunspire temple, which is actually the dragon Nahviintaas. She offers the Vestige travel there.
Nazdar is an elderly Khajiit musician and former adept of the Whispering Claw in who resides at The Stitches, Northern Elsweyr.
Neeta-Jasa is an Argonian residing in the Gladiator's Quarters outside of Solitude.
Nelos Drurel is a Dunmer residing in the Solitude Mages Guild in Solitude.
Netinndel is an Altmer achievement furnisher residing in Dragon's Hearth in Solitude.

Navlos is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact in who resides alongside Maheelius and Smiles-With-Knife at their camp in Greenshade. They act as a trio of bosses and are responsible for the capture of a Bosmer scouting party from Longhaven.
Nesh-Deeka is an Argonian who runs Nesh-Deeka's Shop of Musical Wonders in Lilmoth.
Neeti-Ra is an Argonian banker that works at the Lilmoth Countinghouse in Lilmoth.
Neski Skull-Sabre is a Nord in that is a part of the Bittercup Creation Club content. She is the leader of a group of bandits at Watchtower Barracks in Falkreath Watchtower.
The Nature Spirit is a Spriggan spirit located in at the Falinesti Autumn Site, Reaper's March, in . She is summoned by Ongalion upon completion of the quest "Gentle Gardener."

The Night Mother, also known as the Unholy Matron, the Shrouded Lady, Blood Flower the Lady Death, and the Mistress of the Void, is the bride of Sithis, the Dread Father of the Dark Brotherhood. Those who wish to have someone assassinated pray to the Night Mother by performing the Black Sacrament, and she extends their requests to her Listener, who in turn passes the task on to the Speakers. It is debatable whether she was a single person, a title passed down through the eras, or an immortal spirit.

Nilioniel is a Bosmer Scout in Molag Mar, Morrowind. She can be found at The Pilgrim's Rest in the city's waistworks where she offers melee skill training. Nilioniel equips a set of netch leather armor and wields a chitin shortbow. She is not involved in any quests.

New-Shoes Bragor is a Bosmer thief, and a member of the Thieves Guild. As his name suggests, he wears a pair of exquisite shoes, far nicer than the rest of his (common) clothing. He is currently imprisoned in Fort Pelagiad facing a number of charges. The prisoner log states that he is being held for theft, attempted robbery, conspiracy, consorting with thieves, and resisting arrest.

Newheim the Portly is a rosy-cheeked Nord citizen living in the town of Anvil. Newheim the Portly's House is located next to Pinarus Inventius' house near the Fighters Guild. He is most often found on the Gold Coast docks outside of Anvil. He is an avid drinker; the quest "Newheim's Flagon" is directly related to him.
Nine-Toes is an Argonian hunter member of the Blades who resides in his house in Balmora.
Niraegaer is a Bosmer assassin and criminal hiding in Hrota Cave, located north of Anvil.
Nevosi Hlan is a Dunmer living in Ebonheart, and the shipmaster of the Chun-Ook. For a fee, he is willing to transport the Nerevarine to new areas.

Nikulas was a Nord warrior. He is a hero, and his ghost can be found inside the Hall of Valor in Sovngarde. He, along with Erlendr and Hunroor, was turned into a stone pillar at Brodir Grove by the wizard Grimkell while searching for Sovngarde. Ulfgar the Unending later avenged them by killing Grimkell. Nikulas and his companions eventually did find Sovngarde.

Nigidius the Needy is an Imperial beggar who is living in the city of Skingrad. He is involved in the quest "Speechcraft Training" along with all the other beggars. He is able to infect the player with Brain rot.
Nevena Ules is a Dunmer noble and a councilor for House Hlaalu, who resides in Ules Manor.
Nina is a Dunmer Enforcer residing in Tel Mora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni.
Nevos Urns is a Dunmer drillmaster and member of the Camonna Tong who resides in the No Name Club in Vivec City.

Nibani Maesa is a Dunmer Wise Woman and a leader of the Nerevarine cult. She resides in the Wise Woman's Yurt. She sells a variety of potions and other miscellaneous items as well as being a spellmaker.
Nilos Talds is a Dunmer warrior working for House Redoran as a Hireling. He is located in Morvayn Quarters, within the Redoran Council Hall.
Nevrila Areloth is a Dunmer Thief who operates a Camonna Tong hideout in Sadrith Mora in a small cave in the back of her house.

Nidryne Redas is a guard in Venim Manor in Ald'ruhn. She is one of the guards tasked with preventing the escape or rescue of Varvur Sarethi from a secret room in the manor. She is otherwise uninvolved in any quests, and does not have any unique dialogue.

Nille Elf-Daughter was a Nord bard and follower of Azura. They are mentioned in the Worn, Faded Note during the quest "Azura." Nille Elf-Daughter wears light armor, with a guaranteed cuirass, shield and greaves of the best quality for the Hero's level, along with a 25% chance of a pair of boots and pair of gauntlets. She wields a leveled blade that can be enchanted at level three or above. She may cast a leveled illusion spell.
Nevon Verilnith is a Dunmer Archer, and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is typically found on the roof of the stronghold's keep, and will not be hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Nidara Herandus is a Dunmer Agent and hostile Skill trainer who resides in the Daedric Ruins of Ald Sotha.
Nevusa Veleth is a Dunmer Mage found in the West Gash Region outside the Daedric shrine of Maelkashishi. She is hostile to the Nerevarine and attacks on sight.

The Nightlord Vampire is a radiant vampire sub-type introduced in . They are the highest level standard vampire that can be encountered and can be found in a multitude of locations. They are set at level 60.

Nevrasa Dralor is a Dunmer pilgrim of the Tribunal Temple who can be found northwest of Pelagiad. She is on her way to the Fields of Kummu to pray for the same humility Lord Vivec showed to a farmer. However, she is unable to get there on her own and has asked for an escort.
Nilas Brilyn is a Dunmer Crusader who resides in the Daedric Ruins of Ald Sotha.
Nind Dudnebisun is a Dunmer Scout who resides at the Yakaridan Camp in the Grazelands of Morrowind.
Nicolene is a Breton who resides in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai in . She is a member of Captain Kaleen's crew and has two brothers serving in the Daggerfall Covenant.
Ninirrasour is a Dunmer Herder, and Ashlander that lives in the Urshilaku Camp and takes up residence in Shara's Yurt.
Nicolas Elve is an Breton laborer who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found in the Daggerfall Marketplace, near one of the stands.
Niden Naros is a Dunmer noble who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Nevil Malvayn is a Dunmer pilgrim and member of Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Canon Quarters in the Vivec, Temple Canton.
Nilas Oran is a Dunmer mystic and a member of the Mages Guild residing in Woodhearth. He is found at the local branch selling his wares.

Nilbedel is a Bosmer residing in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood. She is a member of the local Mages Guild. She is married to Ferlion, who is a member of the Aldmeri Dominion. A note can be found in Elden Root that describes how he died a hero, near Desiccated Cave.
Nilera Ieneth is a Dunmer farmer who can be found outside her farmhouse in the Ascadian Isles.

Nilwen is a Bosmer who can be found in the Rift just northeast of Ivarstead. She lives alone in her small shack in the middle of the woods. She talks of "great" and "dangerous" beasts in the area when in fact, she is a criminial using her ruse to trick travelers into killing themselves and looting them.

Nilara Ienth is a Dunmer and sister to Milore Ienth. She along with her lover Athras left Solstheim and returned to Morrowind were they own a manor in Mournhold. Nilara mentions in her letter that they haven't visited the old manor for fifty years now, but says that nothing has really changed to the place. Later on she tells her sister that Athras have returned to work as a jewelcrafter in the city. Nilara says that he brings in a lot of coin to the manor, and at the rate things are going for them now, she looks forward to see the manor in its full glory in the future.
Niima is an Argonian commoner who resides in Davon's Watch in Stonefalls. She can be found outside The Fish Stink talking to Deep-in-Cups.
Nikulund is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Davon's Watch.
Nilleth is a Bosmer general goods merchant in who works at her shop, Hermit's Hoard, under the main bridge in the middle of Skywatch city.
Khamala is a Bosmer bard who can be found at Khalama's Caravan, an impromptu caravan nearby Shattered Shoals.
Nilyne Hlor is a Dunmer residing in the Verobar House in Quarantine Serk. She is seeking help in finding a way to slow down the spreading of the Llodos Plague.
Nida is a Dunmer member of Mages Guild. She is an instructor and can be found teaching other members at the guild hall on Eyevea.
Niluva Alan is a Dunmer guarding the southeast gate of Dragonstar.
Nilu al-Rihad is a character found in the Alik'r Desert city of Bergama.
Nimble-Hands is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact residing in Fort Amol.
Nimaima is a Redguard residing at Thoda's Home in the city of Sentinel. She's General Thoda's wife.
Ninette Cedmain is a Breton patron of the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Nicolard is a Breton located inside Bhosek the Bloody's palace in Port Hunding, in the region of Stros M'Kai. He is the author of A Call to Action!.
Ninglenel is a Bosmer and the husband of Mizahabi. She is seeking help and finding him. Afterwards, he can be found in Hoarfrost Downs in Rivenspire.
Ningor is a Bosmer residing in the town of Elden Root. He is in a relationship with Tervur Sadri and acts rather aggressive and mocking towards the Vestige.
Nilas Urbyn is a Breton brewer. He works at The Sloshing Tankard in Northpoint.
Neyna is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is the armsman of their branch in Davon's Watch.

Nineclaws is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is part of a small scouting party that was captured by a Ebonheart Pact spies and brought to their camp in Greenshade. Once freed, she returns to Woodhearth.
Nilus Othran is a Dunmer found resting in the inn of Selfora.
Nimble-Knuckles is an Argonian residing in Xal Ithix, Shadowfen.
Nimshat is a Redguard laborer found in the city of Orsinium. He has no unique dialogue.
Nettira is a deceased Nord member of the Fighters Guild and the cousin of Grundskar. She was killed while investigating Mal Sorra's Tomb. She is the author of Nettira's Journal.
Nightmare Butcher is an Undead creature that appears in Sathram Plantation, in Stonefalls, Morrowind. It can also be found in Skald's Retreat in The Rift, during the quest "Song of Awakening."
Nightmare Defilers are generic Khajiit Dro-m'Athra found at the Sathram Plantation in Stonefalls.
Nightmare Ravager is an Undead creature that appears in Sathram Plantation, in Stonefalls, Morrowind. This creature also appears in Skald's Retreat, during the related quest there.
Nicolas is an Imperial thief. He is the former guildmaster of the Abah's Landing Thieves Guild. He serves as the main antagonist of .
Nimare is an Altmer stablemaster who runs Nimare's Noble Steeds in Marbruk.
Nevusa is a Dunmer member of the Dark Brotherhood. She is found in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
Nimble-Fingers is an Argonian bard. She is found amidst the ruins of Hackdirt in the Western Rise.
Nielaenor is a Bosmer residing in Skywatch. She watches and bets on the local frog races.
Nielas is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful. She is held captive by Wood Orcs of the Lhurgash Clan that invaded the Falinesti Spring Site.
Nildedrin is a Bosmer patron of the Stone Oasis Inn in Bergama. He can be found in the upstairs of the inn, standing by the top of the east staircase.
Nilenarth is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful. She is found at the Falinesti Winter Site.
Niliendras is a Bosmer magus and member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Hallin's Stand.
Nimriell is a Bosmer scholar. She is part of a small team conducting research on the kwama found within the Burroot Kwama Mine.
Nielstig is a Nord New Life Festival celebrant who may be found south of Windhelm, Eastmarch.
Nil the Bard is a Dunmer bard performing at the Cold Moon Inn in Windhelm. He is in love with Innbild Cold-Moon.
Nila Belavel is a Dunmer part of the research team trapped within Pinepeak Cavern.
Nilthis is a Dunmer working as a messenger on behalf of Drathus Othral, the mayor of Ebonheart.
Nezashun is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate.
Nibihu is a Khajiit member of the Baandari Clan. He is found in their camp at the Martyr's Crossing. He cannot be interacted with.
Nielsar is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Amol. He is a patron of Deldwine's inn.
Nikaolde is a Nord residing in Nimalten. She is one of the many targets assigned via contracts in The Rift.

Nikolvara the Durzog Trainer is a Nord beastmaster found in her underground kennel. Her talent for taming wild creatures such as durzogs has attracted the attention of the Dragonstar Caravan Company, which seeks to determine the source of her skills.
Nevon Uleni is a Dunmer residing in Ald'ruhn, in Vvardenfell.
Nightmare Deadeye is a generic Deadeye residing in several locations in .
Nevos Sareloth is a Dunmer caravaner residing in Balmora on Vvardenfell.
Nimithil is a Bosmer farmer residing in Bramblebreach in the region of Greenshade. She is often encountered while fishing.
The Ninendava Sacred Goat is a pet goat in . It was available from Dwarven Crown Crates as an epic reward.
Nial Sextius is an Imperial Legionary who served during Titus Mede's reign.
Neviral is a Redguard priest of Tu'whacca held hostage by the Withered Hand at Tu'whacca's Throne.
Night Runner Venomblades are generic members of the Night Runners found in several locations throughout Summerset, including Karnwasten.
Night Runner Vanquishers are generic members of the Night Runners found in several locations throughout Summerset, including Karnwasten.
Niha is a Redguard residing in Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in .
Nirahni is an Alfiq residing in Riverhold, Northern Elsweyr.
Friar Hadelar is a hostile Altmer member of Bronzefists found in Nchuleftingth Ruins on Vvardenfell. He is one of the bosses of the location.
Nilthin al-Bergama is a character located in Rivenspire, High Rock, in .

Nevena Nirith is a Dunmer member of the Sixth House. She can be found in the Wakener's Halls inside the Forgotten Wastes, where she is fought alongside Wakener Maras. She has a diary describing her being turned into a member of the Sixth House. Formerly, she was an apprentice historian in the Tribunal Temple, but after receiving a Sixth House statue she killed her Master Historian and fled, pursed by her brother, Tythis Nirith.
Nightstealer Sorina is a hostile Shrike found in the Ebon Sanctum part of Ebon Stadmont in Summerset.
Nias Othralas is a Dunmer residing in Holamayan Monastery in Vvardenfell.
Nhorhim is a blind Nord Roister's Club member and grand Tribute master. <!--
Nireli Farys is a Dunmer shipmaster living in Tel Branora. She is a member of House Telvanni, and her boat can take the Nerevarine to Sadrith Mora, Ebonheart, Vivec City and Molag Mar.
Norbert Lelles is a Breton trader and the proprietor of Lelles' Quality Merchandise outside of the walls of Anvil. He sells general goods, and is an Apprentice in Mercantile skill.
Nirtunus Crunus is an Imperial Agent who can be found in Beshara. He is hostile and will attack on sight; however, if calmed, he will offer training in Speechcraft, Light Armor and Sneak.
Nitterius Rato is an Imperial warrior and slaver who resides in Aharunartus along with Brothes Oran, Valund, and Yatur gro-Shak.
Niruin is a Bosmer thief and a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften. He is a Master skill trainer of Archery.
Nirya is an Altmer sorceress in who resides in the College of Winterhold. As a student, she has a grudge against Faralda, but claims it is the other way around.
Niranye is an Altmer general goods merchant found in the marketplace in Windhelm.
No-Coins Draninus is an Imperial beggar residing in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City. The Hero can contract Collywobbles from him, should the two in engage in combat.
Nivan Dalvilu is a Dunmer warlock who resides in his home in the village of Bleaker's Way north of the Imperial City. He is the patriarch of the Dalvilu family.
Norasa Adus is a Dunmer worshipper of the Daedric Prince Hermaeus Mora found at the Shrine of Hermaeus Mora.
Nistacey is a hostile Redguard warrior encountered in the slaver cave of Zainsipilu.
Nirasa Aren is a Dunmer commoner who can be found in Sadrith Mora.
Nobleman is an Imperial skooma addict who is found inside Redwater Den. He is incapacitated, and thus only lies on a mat in the den's reception room.
Noldrasi Bedas is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Niras Farys is a priest found in the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora. He is a vendor who sells spells, books and potions. He is also a Spellmaker.
Nomu is an Agaceph Argonian from Black Marsh during the Third Era. He helped Decumus Scotti navigate through the Black Marsh's thick swamps in order for him to reach the Imperial City.
Noleon Sele is a Breton spellsword who resides in the tower of Hanud. He is a hireling of House Telvanni, and will attack the Nerevarine on sight, even if they are a fellow member.
Nona is a Bosmer commoner who resides in her house in Tel Mora.

Nirai Ashishpalirdan is a Dunmer Mabrigash residing in a small camp in the Ashlands. She is typically found with her friends Pilu Shilansour and Assamanu Shashipal, in a small campsite between Bal Isra and Maar Gan. They are hostile towards the Nerevarine, and will attack them on sight.
